bank_name: Global Islami Bank PLC (formerly NRB Global Bank Limited)
period_note: Unaudited interim financial statements 'As at 31 March 2023'. Balance sheet is the period-end snapshot; comparative column is 31 December 2022 (matches this dataset's own audited 2022_Q4.json total equity of 12,964m and total assets of 153,811m closely, within a small ~100m/~0.07% gap attributable to this interim report's own comparative-column rounding, not a restatement of the audited figure). CRITICAL CONTEXT for the equity-crossing-negative question this research pass was aimed at: this filing shows Total Shareholders' Equity of 13,533.35m as at 31 March 2023 -- POSITIVE, and slightly UP from the 12,964m implied for Dec-2022 -- with a quarterly net profit of 574.81m. On an as-originally-filed basis, GIB was solidly profitable and growing through Q1 2023; the eventual audited FY2023 full-year LOSS of -21,520.25m (and negative equity of -9,026.18m) that this dataset's 2023_Q4.json records did not begin to show up in the bank's own quarterly disclosures this early in the year -- see 2023_Q2.json and 2023_Q3.json for how this trajectory continued, and 2024_Q1.json for the discovery of a large retroactive restatement between when these interim filings were made and when the FY2023 annual report was finally audited (18 months after year-end). Total assets is a calculated_from_liabilities_plus_equity figure (133,639,165,521 liabilities [itself a clean sum of Placement, Deposits and Other Liabilities] + 13,533,349,494 equity = 147,172,515,015) because the source PDF's own 'Total assets' cell fell inside a shaded/boxed table row that pdftotext corrupted into unreadable characters; the two independent paths (this sum, and an asset-side component sum) agree to within 0.007%, an immaterial residual traced to one minor, similarly-corrupted deferred-tax-asset cell. Income-statement figures are for Jan-Mar 2023, both discrete and cumulative since it is the first quarter.
